Here are solid Williamson County options that *commonly* price under $10K for a full-day meeting (especially on weekdays) **when structured as a day meeting package or when the room rental is waived with a food and beverage minimum**. You will want to confirm final quotes, since pricing varies by date, day of week, and AV needs.

## Best-fit venues to price first (100 to 150, breakout rooms, bar, coffee/lunch)

### 1) Franklin Marriott Cool Springs (Franklin)
- **Why it fits:** Large conference hotel with **23 event rooms** and onsite restaurant + bar. citeturn1search0turn1search8turn1search27  
- **Food:** In-house catering is standard for meetings. citeturn1search7turn1search11  
- **Bar/mixer:** Onsite bar and lounge. citeturn1search8turn1search24  

### 2) Hilton Franklin Cool Springs (Franklin)
- **Why it fits:** **7 meeting rooms** and solid total event space, good for a main room + breakouts. citeturn0search2  
- **Bar/mixer:** Full service hotel with bar/lounge and restaurant. citeturn0search14turn0search22  
- **Food:** Hotel banquet team supports catering for breaks and meals. citeturn0search2  

### 3) Embassy Suites by Hilton Franklin Cool Springs (Franklin)
- **Why it fits:** Built for groups, with substantial meeting space and flexible rooms. citeturn0search5turn0search21  
- **Bar/mixer:** Embassy properties typically have an evening reception and onsite dining options. citeturn0search9turn0search17  
- **Food:** In-house catering is typical for meetings.

### 4) Drury Plaza Hotel Nashville Franklin (Franklin)
- **Why it fits:** Multiple meeting rooms and a reputation for value-focused group pricing. citeturn1search2turn1search17  
- **Food:** They offer flexible catering options. citeturn1search17  
- **Outside catering:** Listed as **outside caterers allowed** on venue listings. citeturn1search10  
- **Capacity:** Venue listings show standing capacity around the range you need. citeturn1search10  
*(Ask specifically about a staffed bar for your evening mixer, since some Drury locations are lighter on “traditional bar” setups.)*

### 5) The Factory at Franklin (Franklin)
- **Why it fits:** Unique non-hotel option with multiple event spaces (you can do your general session + adjacent breakout). citeturn0search3turn0search19turn0search31  
- **Breakouts:** Liberty Hall has adjacent rooms and amenities called out in listings. citeturn3image2turn3image6  
- **Bar:** The Factory has onsite bar concepts (example: Skylight). citeturn0search11  
- **Food:** Often works with preferred caterers or event partners, depending on the space. citeturn3image2  
*(This one can be under or over $10K depending on which space and what you add, so it is worth pricing, but do not assume.)*

### 6) SpringHill Suites Franklin Cool Springs (Franklin)
- **Why it fits:** Has **breakout rooms** and an onsite bar called The Library Bar & Eatery. citeturn1search4  
- **Heads up:** Double-check capacity for 100 to 150 seated classroom/theater, since some select-service hotels cap out lower.

## Also worth pricing in Brentwood (Williamson County)
### Hilton Garden Inn Nashville Brentwood
- **Why it fits:** Capacity chart shows **up to 150** for reception/theater in their larger room setups. citeturn2search21  

### Sheraton Nashville Brentwood
- **Why it fits:** Lists a ballroom that welcomes **up to 150** in banquet setting. citeturn2search3  

## What to ask for so you stay under $10K
Copy/paste this into your inquiry emails:
- “One main room for 100 to 150, plus 2 to 3 breakout rooms”
- “Coffee on arrival, continuous water, afternoon break”
- “Simple lunch (boxed or buffet)”
- “Cash bar or hosted bar for 60 to 90 minutes for an evening mixer”
- “We are open to a food and beverage minimum if it waives room rental”
- “Please include service charges, taxes, and AV in the estimate”

If you tell me your target date (or even just month, weekday vs weekend, and whether you need microphones/projector), I can narrow this to the 3 most likely to land under $10K with the least friction.
